_comment: Copy to settings.json and edit. Every key is optional; missing keys use the defaults shown here. Relative paths are resolved from this file's folder.

criteria.Target roles: Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Product Manager, Product Owner
criteria.Locations: Example City (remote / hybrid / onsite); remote within the home country; abroad only with visa sponsorship
criteria.Salary: Keep if not listed. Drop only if the stated maximum is below the floor you set here
criteria.Experience: Skip if the minimum required is 7+ years
criteria.Certifications: Skip if a certification you do not hold is mandatory; 'preferred' is fine
criteria.Exclude companies: Your current employer; anywhere you already applied
